subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should known Google/Gemini auth-profile env-ref keys be delivered through the existing generated systemd EnvironmentFile contract instead of inline unit `Environment=` assignments?
rationale: The code change is narrow and appears correct, but it intentionally changes credential delivery for provider auth profiles and hardcodes provider-specific key names in core, so maintainer/security intent should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Accept File-Backed Google/Gemini Auth Refs
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer/security review accepts the existing `environmentValueSources: "file"` contract for these known credential names.

options.title: Move Key Policy To Provider Metadata
options.body: Ask for a pre-merge refactor that lets the Google provider declare which auth-profile env refs must be file-backed instead of hardcoding names in core.

options.title: Pause The Auth-Profile Portion
options.body: Leave the merged config SecretRef fix in place and pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want auth-profile env refs moved to generated EnvironmentFile storage.

recommendation.title: Accept File-Backed Google/Gemini Auth Refs
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer/security review accepts the existing `environmentValueSources: "file"` contract for these known credential names.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for daemon install/service-env planning and is the best available owner for this security-boundary choice.
